parts.text: Many ﬂ owers produce volatile oils. These oils are responsible for the sweet scent (perfume) of many ﬂ owers.

parts.text: (d) A radioactive isotope of carbon called carbon-14 can be used to date old pieces of cloth.

ms.label: 7(d)(i)

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Carbon-14 contains 8 neutrons and 6 protons. The symbol for carbon-14 can be written 14 C 6 . Write the symbol for carbon-12 in a similar way. [1]
